About the work from home job/internship

She Can Foundation works for the empowerment of women and girls through education, skill development, and livelihood support. This internship is an opportunity to contribute to that mission by supporting the foundation's fundraising efforts.

Selected intern's day-to-day responsibilities include:

1. Reaching out to individuals and communities and encouraging them to contribute to the foundation's cause.
2. Sharing the foundation's fundraising campaigns across WhatsApp and social media platforms.
3. Liaising with the foundation team to receive campaign material and share updates with donors.

On successful completion of the internship, interns will receive a certificate of completion and a letter of recommendation from the foundation. Guidance and support will be provided by the foundation team throughout the internship.

Performance-based stipend: 20% of the total funds raised.

About She Can Foundation

Delhi
The She Can Foundation is an NGO, registered under the Indian Societies Registration Act of 1860, dedicated to uplifting and empowering underprivileged women. Our mission is to provide education, training, and resources to help women from marginalized communities overcome obstacles and achieve their full potential. We work to promote gender equality, increase access to healthcare and education, and provide opportunities for economic growth and development. Through our programs and initiatives, we strive to create a world where every woman has the resources and support she needs to thrive and succeed. Join us in our mission to empower women and help build a brighter future for all.
